title: Operations Bible
boundary: Record definitions and transitions are proposed product configuration. Classification and a valid transition do not create approval, risk acceptance, merge authority, publication authority or delegated authority.

recordTypes.label: Case
recordTypes.purpose: Hold the outcome, context, history and related work for one defined matter.
recordTypes.boundary: A Case is a flexible container, not a compulsory workflow for everything.
recordTypes.definition: The main container for an outcome, issue, need or body of related work.
recordTypes.useWhen: Several actions, decisions or operational records contribute to one outcome.
recordTypes.avoidWhen: A single lightweight task is enough and no wider history needs to be retained.
methodologyQuestions: What outcome is this Case trying to create?
Who is affected and who owns the outcome?
recordTypes.approval: Creating or organising a Case does not approve any consequential action.
recordTypes.automation: Capture and routing may be assisted; consequential decisions remain governed.

open.label: Start case
open.outcome: The Case becomes active and remains the context for its connected work.

open.label: Put case on hold
open.outcome: The Case remains open with the reason for waiting retained.

in-progress.label: Resolve case
in-progress.outcome: The intended Case outcome is recorded as reached, ready for closure review.

in-progress.label: Put case on hold
in-progress.outcome: The Case remains open with the reason for waiting retained.

waiting.label: Resume case
waiting.outcome: The Case returns to active work.

waiting.label: Resolve case
waiting.outcome: The intended Case outcome is recorded as reached.

resolved.label: Close case
resolved.outcome: The resolved Case leaves the open inbox while its history remains available.

resolved.label: Reopen case
resolved.outcome: The Case returns to active work with the reason retained.

recordTypes.label: Request
recordTypes.purpose: Retain demand for an outcome, service, change or explanation.
recordTypes.boundary: A Request states demand; it is not authority to fulfil it by any means.
recordTypes.definition: Something somebody wants to happen, receive, change or understand.
recordTypes.useWhen: There is a clear requested outcome or fulfilment need.
recordTypes.avoidWhen: The item is only a small executable step within existing work.
methodologyQuestions: What outcome is being requested?
What authority and evidence constrain fulfilment?
approvalGates: Any consequential fulfilment follows the applicable Change or Approval.
recordTypes.approval: A Request can be fulfilled only within the applicable authority and change policy.
recordTypes.automation: May be manual, assisted, standard pre-authorised or zero-touch where policy permits.

new.label: Qualify request
new.outcome: The requested outcome is clear enough to route and progress.

qualified.label: Start fulfilment
qualified.outcome: Fulfilment begins within the applicable authority.

qualified.label: Close without fulfilment
qualified.outcome: The reason for not fulfilling the Request is retained.

in-progress.label: Record fulfilment
in-progress.outcome: The delivered outcome is retained, ready for closure.

in-progress.label: Wait for input
in-progress.outcome: The dependency or missing input is retained.

waiting.label: Resume fulfilment
waiting.outcome: The Request returns to active fulfilment.

fulfilled.label: Close request
fulfilled.outcome: The fulfilled Request leaves the open inbox.

fulfilled.label: Reopen request
fulfilled.outcome: The Request returns to fulfilment with the reason retained.

recordTypes.label: Task
recordTypes.purpose: Retain one bounded executable action and its outcome.
recordTypes.boundary: A Task is not a substitute for a Request, Change, Risk, Decision or Approval when their history matters.
recordTypes.definition: A lightweight executable action that should not become a formal request by default.
recordTypes.useWhen: One clear action can be completed by an owner.
recordTypes.avoidWhen: The work needs its own outcome, approval, investigation or risk history.
methodologyQuestions: What is the smallest useful action?
What outcome or evidence shows it is done?
recordTypes.approval: Completing a Task records execution, not approval of a wider decision.
recordTypes.automation: Repeatable low-consequence Tasks may be automated within an approved rule.

to-do.label: Mark task done
to-do.outcome: The completion remains in activity history.

in-progress.label: Mark task done
in-progress.outcome: The completion remains in activity history.

in-progress.label: Record blocker
in-progress.outcome: The cause of blocked work is retained.

blocked.label: Remove blocker and resume
blocked.outcome: The Task returns to active work.

blocked.label: Mark task done
blocked.outcome: The completion remains in activity history.

recordTypes.label: Incident
recordTypes.purpose: Restore and learn from an unexpected disruption, failure or harmful event.
recordTypes.boundary: An Incident manages the live event; a linked Problem may investigate its cause.
recordTypes.definition: An unexpected disruption, failure, harmful event or loss of expected service.
recordTypes.useWhen: Something has gone wrong or the expected operation has been disrupted.
recordTypes.avoidWhen: The work is a planned request or a possible future uncertainty only.
methodologyQuestions: What must be restored now?
What evidence distinguishes the event from its possible cause?
approvalGates: Material recovery and residual-risk choices follow named authority.
recordTypes.approval: Urgent containment may be delegated; material risk and recovery decisions retain named authority.
recordTypes.automation: Detection and bounded response may be automated with monitoring, escalation and recovery.

reported.label: Triage incident
reported.outcome: Impact, ownership and the response route can be confirmed.

triaged.label: Resolve incident
triaged.outcome: Restoration and its evidence are retained.

responding.label: Resolve incident
responding.outcome: Restoration and its evidence are retained.

monitoring.label: Resolve incident
monitoring.outcome: Restoration and its evidence are retained.

monitoring.label: Resume response
monitoring.outcome: Response resumes with the reason retained.

resolved.label: Close incident
resolved.outcome: The Incident leaves the open inbox while evidence remains.

resolved.label: Reopen incident
resolved.outcome: Response resumes with the reason retained.

recordTypes.label: Problem
recordTypes.purpose: Investigate an understood or suspected underlying cause.
recordTypes.boundary: A Problem can exist before a cause is proven and does not itself authorise treatment.
recordTypes.definition: An investigation into an underlying, recurring or systemic cause.
recordTypes.useWhen: A serious or repeated signal justifies investigation beyond immediate restoration.
recordTypes.avoidWhen: The immediate Incident or Request can be resolved without a cause investigation.
methodologyQuestions: What evidence supports the suspected cause?
What smaller investigation could disprove it?
approvalGates: Treatment follows the applicable Change or Approval.
recordTypes.approval: A finding or recommendation does not itself authorise treatment.
recordTypes.automation: Pattern detection and evidence preparation may be assisted; causal judgement remains reviewable.

investigating.label: Record known cause
investigating.outcome: The supported cause and uncertainty are retained.

cause-known.label: Record treatment plan
cause-known.outcome: The proposed treatment is retained without approval.

treatment-planned.label: Resolve problem
treatment-planned.outcome: Treatment evidence and uncertainty are retained.

resolved.label: Close problem
resolved.outcome: The Problem leaves the open inbox while causal evidence remains.

resolved.label: Reopen investigation
resolved.outcome: Investigation resumes with the reason retained.

recordTypes.label: Change
recordTypes.purpose: Govern an alteration to a service, process, product, control or method.
recordTypes.boundary: Preparation and technical readiness do not authorise implementation, merge, release or publication.
recordTypes.definition: A controlled alteration to a product, service, process, system, policy, control or operation.
recordTypes.useWhen: An agreed outcome requires an alteration whose effect should be assessed and verified.
recordTypes.avoidWhen: The Request can be fulfilled safely without changing the controlled operation.
methodologyQuestions: What should change and what must remain unchanged?
How will normal, failed and recovery outcomes be tested?
approvalGates: Explicit authority before scheduling or implementation.
Separate release and publication decisions where applicable.
recordTypes.approval: Novel, sensitive or higher-risk Changes require the authorised human or policy decision.
recordTypes.automation: Standard Changes may be pre-authorised; zero-touch execution requires defined rules and verification.

draft.label: Assess change
draft.outcome: Impact, risk, controls and authority can be examined.

assessing.label: Request change approval
assessing.outcome: The Change is ready for an explicit authority decision.
assessing.suggestedNote: Scope, evidence, controls and authority are ready for review.

awaiting-approval.label: Approve and schedule
awaiting-approval.outcome: The Change is authorised for bounded scheduling; implementation has not occurred.
awaiting-approval.suggestedNote: Approved for the bounded scope recorded above; no wider authority is created.

scheduled.label: Start implementation
scheduled.outcome: The authorised Change enters bounded implementation.

implementing.label: Start verification
implementing.outcome: The intended outcome and controls must now be checked.

verifying.label: Complete change
verifying.outcome: Verification evidence and the outcome are retained.

verifying.label: Return to implementation
verifying.outcome: The failed check is retained for correction.

recordTypes.label: Risk
recordTypes.purpose: Retain uncertainty or a condition that could affect intended outcomes.
recordTypes.boundary: A rejected or delayed treatment does not close the underlying Risk.
recordTypes.definition: Uncertainty or a condition that could affect intended outcomes.
recordTypes.useWhen: A signal is credible enough to require ownership, assessment, treatment or monitoring.
recordTypes.avoidWhen: An observation is not yet sufficiently evidenced; retain it as a Finding first.
methodologyQuestions: What outcome and people could be affected?
Who can treat and who can accept residual exposure?
approvalGates: Exact named authority for risk acceptance.
recordTypes.approval: AI may surface a signal; registration, treatment and acceptance follow defined human or policy authority.
recordTypes.automation: Signals may be detected automatically without creating excessive formal Risk records.

signal.label: Assess risk signal
signal.outcome: The signal moves into proportionate assessment.

assessing.label: Register open risk
assessing.outcome: The credible exposure becomes owned open work.

open.label: Start risk treatment
open.outcome: Treatment begins while exposure remains visible.

open.label: Accept risk
open.outcome: Residual exposure, conditions and review trigger remain visible.

treating.label: Move to monitoring
treating.outcome: Treatment evidence and remaining exposure will be observed.

monitoring.label: Close risk
monitoring.outcome: The reason active governance is no longer needed is retained.

monitoring.label: Resume treatment
monitoring.outcome: Treatment resumes with the trigger retained.

monitoring.label: Accept residual risk
monitoring.outcome: Residual exposure and conditions remain visible.

accepted.label: Reassess accepted risk
accepted.outcome: Acceptance is reopened because conditions or evidence changed.

recordTypes.label: Finding
recordTypes.purpose: Retain an evidenced observation and its disposition.
recordTypes.boundary: A Finding does not presume that action or method change is required.
recordTypes.definition: An evidenced observation that requires consideration without presuming an action.
recordTypes.useWhen: Evidence should be retained and assessed before deciding what follows.
recordTypes.avoidWhen: A known executable action or already registered Risk is the clearer record.
methodologyQuestions: What does the evidence support?
What remains inference or assumption?
recordTypes.approval: A Finding can result in no action when the rationale is retained.
recordTypes.automation: Analysis may draft Findings; evidence, interpretation and disposition remain traceable.

recorded.label: Review finding
recorded.outcome: Evidence and possible consequences can be assessed.

actioned.label: Close finding
actioned.outcome: The Finding leaves the open inbox while evidence remains.

recordTypes.label: Improvement
recordTypes.purpose: Retain a learning-led opportunity to improve outcomes or capability.
recordTypes.boundary: An Improvement does not silently commit priority, people or spending.
recordTypes.definition: An intentional effort to improve how the business operates, linked to evidence and outcomes.
recordTypes.useWhen: A Problem or opportunity warrants owned, measured improvement work.
recordTypes.avoidWhen: The idea has no evidence, intended outcome or plausible measure yet.
methodologyQuestions: What would improve and for whom?
How will the outcome be observed?
approvalGates: Priority, spending and implementation follow their applicable authority.
recordTypes.approval: Prioritisation and investment follow the consequence and spending authority involved.
recordTypes.automation: Oppa Mate may identify and prepare opportunities; it does not silently commit resources.

idea.label: Qualify improvement
idea.outcome: Value, evidence and a plausible measure can be compared.

qualified.label: Prioritise improvement
qualified.outcome: The reason for attention is retained without spending authority.

in-progress.label: Start outcome measurement
in-progress.outcome: The change in outcome or capability is measured.

measuring.label: Record improvement embedded
measuring.outcome: The observed outcome and operating change are retained.

embedded.label: Close improvement
embedded.outcome: The Improvement leaves the open inbox while outcome evidence remains.

recordTypes.label: Scenario test
recordTypes.purpose: Explore normal, failure and recovery behaviour before or after change.
recordTypes.boundary: A Scenario Test cannot create uncontrolled harm or access.
recordTypes.definition: A planned exercise used to practise, observe weaknesses, improve and re-test.
recordTypes.useWhen: A plausible failure or operating condition should be tested before it occurs for real.
recordTypes.avoidWhen: A live disruption is already happening; use an Incident.
methodologyQuestions: What normal, adverse and degraded conditions matter?
How will recovery be observed?
approvalGates: Consequential test access or harm requires explicit authority.
recordTypes.approval: The test scope must not create uncontrolled harm or access.
recordTypes.automation: Preparation, observation and evidence capture may be assisted within the approved scenario boundary.

draft.label: Plan scenario test
draft.outcome: Scope, safety boundary and expected evidence are ready.

running.label: Start debrief
running.outcome: Observed behaviour, failures and uncertainty can be retained.

debrief.label: Record actions to complete
debrief.outcome: Follow-up work remains open and connected.

debrief.label: Complete scenario test
debrief.outcome: The outcome and no-further-action reason are retained.

actions-open.label: Schedule re-test
actions-open.outcome: The need to test the changed operation remains visible.

actions-open.label: Complete scenario test
actions-open.outcome: Completed actions and outcome are retained.

re-test.label: Plan re-test
re-test.outcome: The next test is planned against previous evidence.

recordTypes.label: Decision
recordTypes.purpose: Retain a material judgement, rationale, authority and consequence.
recordTypes.boundary: Routine reversible choices may remain in activity history; material choices use this record.
recordTypes.definition: A retained material judgement, authority, rationale, conditions and review trigger.
recordTypes.useWhen: Value, risk, control, release, spending or delegated authority is materially affected.
recordTypes.avoidWhen: Routine low-consequence choices are already clear in activity history.
methodologyQuestions: What exact bounded choice is required?
What remains unauthorised whichever option is chosen?
approvalGates: The named decision maker records the judgement.
recordTypes.approval: The Decision records who held authority; AI cannot infer or acquire it.
recordTypes.automation: AI may prepare evidence and a recommendation, never invent the accountable Decision.

needed.label: Prepare decision
needed.outcome: Evidence, options, trade-offs and authority are ready.
needed.suggestedNote: Evidence, options, trade-offs and authority are prepared for review.

ready.label: Record decision
ready.outcome: The judgement, rationale and authority are retained.

ready.label: Defer decision
ready.outcome: The reason, interim position and review trigger remain visible.

deferred.label: Supersede decision
deferred.outcome: The replacement or reason is retained.

recordTypes.label: Approval
recordTypes.purpose: Retain a named human or explicitly delegated policy authorisation for one bounded transition.
recordTypes.boundary: Classification, recommendation, readiness, silence and continued discussion are not approval.
recordTypes.definition: A permitted human or policy authorisation for a bounded action or transition.
recordTypes.useWhen: A defined gate requires explicit authority before work may progress.
recordTypes.avoidWhen: A review, recommendation or technical readiness signal is being mistaken for authority.
methodologyQuestions: What exact transition would this authorise?
What remains explicitly unauthorised?
approvalGates: Exact approver confirmation and decision time.
recordTypes.approval: Silence, continued discussion and an AI recommendation are never Approval.
recordTypes.automation: A policy may approve only where the Operations Bible explicitly delegates that authority.

requested.label: Prepare approval decision
requested.outcome: The bounded action, evidence and authority are ready.
requested.suggestedNote: Scope, evidence and authority are prepared for review.

ready.label: Approve
ready.outcome: The bounded action is explicitly authorised; no wider permission is created.
ready.suggestedNote: Approved within the recorded scope and authority boundary; no wider permission is created.
